description: The Voxel Inspector's 'Bounds' panel, expanded, for the Cylinder procedural tileset (Cesium 1.127). Fields shown: Max Radius 1, Min Radius 0, Max Height 3.141592653589 (pi), Min Height -3.141592653589 (-pi), Max Angle 0.530985915492, Min Angle -0.460563380287 (approx). The rendered object in the 3D view is a full, uncut sphere-like globe with no wedge missing -- consistent with the Height fields (set to a full -pi..pi span) actually driving the angle axis (producing a complete revolution, no cut), while the Angle fields (set to a narrow ~1 radian span) actually drive the height axis (producing a very short/flattened cylinder that reads as a globe rather than a tall cylinder).

The Voxel Inspector's 'Clipping' panel, expanded (Bounds panel collapsed), for the same Cylinder tileset, captured mid-drag on the 'Max Height' field (value 1.207964499197, slider partway across); 'Min Height' reads -3.141592653589 and 'Max Angle' reads 1. The rendered cylinder now has a visible magenta/purple angular wedge missing from its top, curving down to an orange band -- the visual signature of an angular clip, not a height clip -- even though the field being dragged is the one labeled 'Max Height'.
